title: AntiHunter full-web port and validation plan for ESP32-S3 N16R8

safety_decision.reason: The completed workflow never enumerates, opens, erases, uploads to, or otherwise communicates with a physical USB device.
safety_decision.hardware_gate: A physical upload requires explicit acceptance of nonzero recoverable risk plus exact board identity and recovery verification.

phases.name: Repository and inventory audit
evidence: Original target is Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 with qio_opi PSRAM configuration.
Inventory identifies an unused ESP32-S3 N16R8 dev board with 16 MB flash and 8 MB PSRAM.

phases.name: Safe generic-board feature gates
phases.result: Legacy external SD, GPS, RTC, vibration, PPS, and Meshtastic UART do not initialize or claim GPIOs.

phases.name: Wokwi exact-memory harness
phases.credential: WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN is present in a Git-ignored, owner-readable local .env file.
phases.result: Merged factory image booted with 8 MB octal PSRAM, SoftAP, web server, and PSRAM-backed detection queues; the expected boot marker was observed.
limitations: Promiscuous Wi-Fi and RF performance still require real hardware.

phases.name: Espressif QEMU boot smoke test
phases.expected_marker_observed: ANTIHUNTER DIGINODE v1.0.2 STABLE BOOT COMPLETE
emulator_overrides: Wi-Fi/BLE initialization disabled because QEMU has no ESP32-S3 RF model
phases.known_result: QEMU reports octal PSRAM absent, and the firmware reaches boot complete via its no-PSRAM fallback.

phases.name: Automated build coverage
phases.result: AntiHunter-n16r8-full added to both PlatformIO CI build paths.

phases.name: Exact PSRAM and basic Wi-Fi simulation
phases.attempt_result: Wokwi CLI reported TEST PASSED after observing the expected AntiHunter boot-complete marker.
phases.command: wokwi-cli . --timeout 60000 --expect-text "ANTIHUNTER DIGINODE v1.0.2 STABLE BOOT COMPLETE"

phases.name: Physical preflight
required_inputs: Photo verification of the exact module marking
USB-UART versus native USB connector identification
Documented BOOT and RESET recovery sequence
Explicit user acceptance that physical flashing cannot have a 100 percent no-brick guarantee

phases.name: Physical upload and RF acceptance
tests: SoftAP starts and web UI loads
Wi-Fi promiscuous capture receives controlled test frames
BLE scan receives a controlled beacon
Reset and ROM download recovery work
